## Clarify answers (by orchestrator under "run yourself if necessary"; user can override at the plan-approval gate)

1. Tolerance = TIGHT: logprob epsilon <= 1e-4, accuracy <= 0.5pp delta, Claude-judge alignment <= +/-1 point. Rationale: strict 1e-6 is unrealistic given the documented fp-arithmetic-order nondeterminism in capability.py adapter mode (PeftModel.from_pretrained without merge_and_unload); loose 1e-2 could mask a real bug. Tight catches real divergence while tolerating fp-order noise.

2. Matrix = 3 CELLS: (a) default both-off, (b) EPM_MATERIALIZE_MERGED=0 only, (c) EPM_ISOLATE_EVAL=1 only. Use the single-stage condition c6_vanilla_em (will not trip the a6456933 staged-guard). The two flags are independent (checkpoint materialization vs eval-process isolation) and do not interact, so the 4th both-on cell is unnecessary; isolating each flag is the point.

3. Mismatch fallback = PER-FLAG (option c): merge whichever flags path matches within tolerance even if the other does not; for any out-of-tolerance flag, do NOT merge it and investigate as a real bug (option b spirit). The two fixes are independent.

4. cleanup_vllm hardening = OUT OF SCOPE for #425. File as a separate small follow-up; keep this run focused on the eval-equivalence verification.

Seeds: single seed, SAME seed across all 3 cells. This is a code-path equivalence check (compare paths on identical inputs), not a variance estimate, so one shared seed is correct and sufficient.
